decision: Deferred feasibility finding; no saved strength experiment and no rejection on playing strength.
reason: Eight worlds resolve a lower-quarter tail with two equal-weight draws; eight of 140 historical roots can fill that tail with one weighted atom.
Per-world imaginary-pass reference is a control variate: moving it inside a nonlinear tail aggregator changes which worlds count as adverse.
Repeated fixed-alpha root aggregation does not implement time-consistent dynamic CVaR or belief-state optimal planning.
next_priority: Native public-belief objectives and their historical decision/time mechanism.
future_option: Reconsider only with a separately frozen larger world budget, explicit risk quantity and fresh paired evaluation; not recommended now.
